excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]所拥有的位于[fromfrom.GetName]内的博物天枢在我们获得该星系后被拆除。

它所占据的空间如今物归原主。
excerpt.en:
The Grand Archive owned by [from.GetName] in [fromfrom.GetName] has been dismantled upon our acquisition of the system.

The space it occupied has been returned to us.
